name: CarelonRx (Elevance/Anthem PBM and mail order)
notes: Tier 2. Researched from the public carelonrx.com FAQs, Mobile App and Contact Us pages (no sign-in). Home delivery and specialty prescriptions are paid in the CarelonRx member portal or app (Make a payment, claims history) or by calling the number on the member ID card; payment options are electronic check, credit card and debit card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), so billing.methods bank + card. The app also updates shipping and payment details, communication preferences and password, offers automatic refills and renewals for some prescriptions, and live chat with Pharmacy Member Services. Members are told to call the Pharmacy Services (or Member Services) number on the back of their ID card, available 24/7; the only other public numbers are provider lines (home delivery 833-396-0309), so no contact phone is set. Anthem-covered members are sent to their health plan. Mail-order forms hosted on employer sites (not official sources) say the card or account given with an order is used for future orders; that is not stated on carelonrx.com, so autopay is unsupported (inferred) with a pointer to the ID-card number. No guest payment, payment plan, paperless bill or future-dated payment is described (unsupported, inferred).

guest_pay.note: To pay, log in to the CarelonRx member portal or app, or call the Pharmacy Member Services number on the back of your member ID card (24/7).

autopay.note: CarelonRx does not offer an online AutoPay enrollment for balances. Make a payment in the member portal or app, or call the Pharmacy Member Services number on your member ID card.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not set up online. For payment questions, call the Pharmacy Member Services number on the back of your member ID card, available 24/7.

paperless.note: There is no paperless-billing setting; you can update your communication preferences in the CarelonRx app and see charges in Claims history.

scheduled_payment.note: Payments are made right away; future-dated payments are not offered online.

help.title: Paying for home delivery and specialty prescriptions
paragraphs: Log in to the CarelonRx member portal or app to pay for home delivery or specialty pharmacy prescriptions, or call the member services number on your ID card. You can pay by electronic check, credit card or debit card; CarelonRx takes Visa, MasterCard and American Express.
To see what a drug will cost first, log in and choose Price a Medication, enter the drug name and follow the steps. Your past charges are listed in claims history.
steps: Log In to the member portal or app.
Pick a bank account or card.

help.title: The CarelonRx app
paragraphs: With the CarelonRx app you can check drug costs and coverage, refill mail service prescriptions and check order status, find an in-network pharmacy, view prescription history, make a payment and view claims history, sign up for automatic refills and renewals on certain prescriptions, download a digital ID card, update shipping and payment details, communication preferences and your password, and chat live with Pharmacy Member Services or schedule a call back. It is available for iOS and Android.

help.title: Contacting CarelonRx
paragraphs: Members should call the Pharmacy Services number on the back of their member ID card to speak with a CarelonRx representative (or Member Services if there is no Pharmacy Services number); it is available 24/7, and TTY users can dial 711. If your medical and pharmacy benefits are through Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield or Anthem Blue Cross, call the number on your ID card or use your health plan's website. If you can't find your ID card, use the Contact Us page.
